styleSelection.reason: Warm stone planes and cool dry-edged openings carry the architecture; restrained sepia marks clarify the fine structure.

families.referenceCue: Pale blue clouded sky: connected loaded wash with wet-edge overlap, reserved cloud lights, no detached contour patches; cool planes stay separate from warm masonry.
Ochre and raw-sienna front gable is the focal warm light plane; broad pale foundation, dry middle planes, cool connected shadow glazes, crisp pointed arches.
The long left chimney and receding wall are darker and quieter than the lit gable: connected warm stone washes then a cool glaze crossing courses and openings.
Right chimney and wing use muted warm planes; extension has a bright sloping cap and crisp dark windows. Paint planes first; ink only structural lines.
Yellow-green foreground tree has an irregular connected light canopy, then dry connected olive shadow groups with small sky and wall gaps; a few shaped crisp leaves.
Left shrubs are darker muted olive groups against stone, with lost interior edges and only occasional crisp silhouettes; no leaf stippling.
Narrow ground strip and small figures: pale warm foundation, linked cool ground shadows, painted dark accents; tiny clothing lights stay paper.
